caption:
Weak water pressure isn't your pipes. It's your showerhead.

Most bathrooms still have the plain fixed head that came with the house, and it only does one thing: a single steady stream. When the building's water pressure is already low, that one setting is the whole experience, every single day.

This handheld head gives you eight spray modes plus a 2-mode power wash setting, so you can switch from a wide rinse to a stronger, more focused stream right from your hand. It's rated 4.5 stars by over fifty thousand people.

You get a shower that actually adjusts to what you want that day, for about $30.
